system.description: HuTian ResearchWorld 4.2.0, this project's own install (images :rwe-v4.2.0)

agent.name: Claude Code
agent.how: one agent per role through acpx's ACP adapter in the role's sandbox container

network.search: the shared search tool (MCP server rwe-search in every sandbox) through the same shield
network.web_access: every request of every role through the run's shield proxy, HuTian's mandatory upstream proxy with the shield's CA: the same URL, keyword, id and date rules as the other systems, the shield logs each URL; no direct way out, server-side search and remote tools off (Issue #73)

tools.permissions: acpx --approve-all --non-interactive-permissions fail: every tool call the agent asks for is approved; the role's sandbox container is the boundary
